text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Super Creek has gotten used to playing the villain since she entered the role for the autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite her efforts, people start to notice her gentle nature.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the final battle of the year approaching, it becomes clear that she'll be able to run as her true self.
